title: OBS Websocket Toolkit
subtitle: Debug and control tools for OBS WebSocket protocol

debugger.title: Debugger
debugger.description: Connect OBS, browse API, send requests, view responses and events.

controller.title: Controller
controller.description: Remote control: scenes, sources, audio and transitions.

simulator.title: OBS Simulator
simulator.description: Mock WebSocket responses and events without OBS.

batchRunner.title: Batch Runner
batchRunner.description: Run multiple requests in serial or parallel.

eventMonitor.title: Event Monitor
eventMonitor.description: Timeline of OBS events with filter and export.

screenshotStudio.title: Screenshot Studio
screenshotStudio.description: Preview, tune params and export scene or source screenshots.

streamDeck.title: Stream Deck Lite
streamDeck.description: Custom OBS control panel with buttons bound to WebSocket actions.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: Event or scheduled triggers for request sequences via visual rules.

webhookBridge.title: Webhook Bridge
webhookBridge.description: OBS events to outbound HTTP; external webhooks trigger OBS requests.

multiObs.title: Multi-OBS Manager
multiObs.description: Connect multiple OBS instances, view status and control in one place.
